title: Zephyrine and the Safehouse
author: Vesper Galloway
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
